description: University-wide contracted Copilot Chat service provided to all members with a UTokyo Account, featuring commercial data protection (prompts and chat data are not used to train foundation models). Institutional access never grants coursework or examination permission, Follow the instructor’s rules; UTOL labels apply to assignments created in UTOL.
howToObtain: Use the institutional sign-in route in the captured official Copilot guidance with a UTokyo Account; verify the account and service safeguards.
costToUser: Included for all members with a UTokyo Account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 大学の契約の下で利用できるのは「商用データ保護を備えたMicrosoft Copilot」というサービスで，Microsoftによれば，入力・出力データがMicrosoftのシステムに蓄積・保存されることはなく，いわゆるモデルの学習に利用されることもありません．
全学構成員向けの生成AIサービスは，当面， Microsoft Copilotによる生成AIチャットの提供 を中心として位置付けます ．

description: University-wide contracted chat AI service provided to all members via ECCS Cloud Email (Google Workspace for Education). Data protection terms ensure user data is not used to train AI models or subject to human review. Institutional account availability does not grant permission for coursework assessments, which is strictly governed by the instructor.
howToObtain: Sign in to Google Gemini (gemini.google.com) using your ECCS Cloud Email account (@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp).
costToUser: Included for all members with ECCS Cloud Email accounts.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 東京大学で全学的に契約している生成AIサービスの中で，チャット形式のものとして，主に以下の2つのサービスがあります．
特に 授業においては，生成AIの利用の可否について，授業の特性に応じて担当教員が判断する ことになっています．所属学科や専攻および各授業の担当教員の 指示に従い，認められていない場合には利用しない でください．
2024年9月現在，ECCSクラウドメールアカウントでGeminiを使用する場合，ユーザのデータがAIモデルの改良に使用されることはなく，AIモデルを改良する目的で人間によるレビューを受けることもないことが，Googleより公表されています．

howToObtain: Sign in to Zoom using UTokyo Zoom SSO credentials.
costToUser: Included under UTokyo Zoom campus-wide license.

description: AI features integrated into UTokyo Slack workspaces (channel summaries, search assistance). Basic features equivalent to Pro plan are available in designated university workspaces. Coursework use is governed by instructor directives.

description: Generative AI writing, drafting, and form creation features embedded in Google Docs, Google Slides, and Google Forms, made available starting February 24, 2026 for users assigned Google Workspace for Education Plus licenses. Tool presence in office software does not authorize coursework drafting outside the specific instructor’s permitted range, including custom Other instructions.
howToObtain: Available within Google Docs, Slides, and Forms for users with assigned Education Plus license.
costToUser: Available to users with Google Workspace for Education Plus license.

description: AI research and note-taking assistant tool powered by Gemini models, allowing users to analyze, summarize, and query uploaded documents (PDFs, Docs, web links) under ECCS Cloud Email accounts. Use in research or coursework is governed by research integrity standards and instructor permission.
howToObtain: Sign in to NotebookLM (notebooklm.google.com) using ECCS Cloud Email credentials.
costToUser: Accessible with ECCS Cloud Email account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
NotebookLM
GeminiのAIモデルを用いて，指定した資料等（PDF，Googleドキュメント，YouTubeの動画，ウェブページなど）を分析させ，要約，整理，質問応答，資料作成などができる，アシスタントツールです．
